items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XV, List of Answers on Topics 74:1
items.html: (To the question) For the Nukva does not grow throughout the whole back of ZA, but only by the stature of the AB of the Aba and Ima of the Mazal, as is known. And then, just as Aba and Ima and YESHSUT become a single Partzuf, so too the Nukva Rachel, with the great Nukva in the body of ZA, called the Malchut of ZA, they also become a single Partzuf. And it is found that the Nukva has now taken the aspect of the GAR of the Nukva in the body of ZA, for she was made one with her. (Item 83).
